**Fix: Stuntcar picture freezing during races**
- The picture froze for about 4 seconds shortly after the start of a race, and again every 20 seconds or so, while the game itself carried on. During those stretches the game shows its frames with a graphics-chip command the emulator was waiting on data for, so the screen wasn't updated. Those frames are now shown, and the picture stays live for the whole race.

Includes the recompiler (v0.5) and Remount SD card (v0.6).
